releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
!!! MAJOR PROGRESS RESET !!! ALL PLAYER PROGRESS RESETS AFTER UPDATING. THIS UPDATE IS REQUIRED TO CONTINUE PLAYING.

Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.0.7

- Rebalanced progression with 100 additional rebirth tiers and 500 additional axe upgrades.
- Added 500 collectible axe skins and 500 chicken breeds across expanded rarities.
- Added five total case types, including mutated axe and chicken cases.
- Added Upgrade Max to tools, research using eggs, pets, and machines with a 500-level cap.
- Added bulk axe selling by locker filter, rarity, and value threshold.
- Quick Open now shares a one-minute cooldown and reports reward rarity and mutation.
- Prestige is now an ultimate reset of axe skins, chickens, eggs, research, and run progression.
- Existing saves remain in the old save file as a backup; new progress starts in a fresh save.
